distinctFrom.why: Separates encumbered cash and transfer barriers explicitly before settlement; existing broad treasury report does not provide this controlled availability bridge.
Builds ordered intraday settlement buckets and minimum liquidity, rather than 30/60/90-day forecast bands or a generic runway estimate.
Allocates signed intercompany cash-pool interest with a balancing pool-center residual; broad treasury sweeps do not supply this entity-level calculation.
Produces dated currency-unit exposure and settlement mismatch rather than a broad hedge recommendation or unsupported VaR estimate.
Reconciles cash on one already contracted buy-forward and its payable, without claiming fair value, option pricing or a hedge recommendation.
Maps separate repricing fractions on two floating-rate facilities to incremental cash interest; it does not value swaps or advise hedges.
Matches contracted service counts and credit allowances to billed bank charges; generic invoice arithmetic lacks balance-credit and service evidence.
Tests signed treasury flow errors and cumulative cash drift against frozen dated forecasts; broad budget variance does not distinguish net-flow bias from cash-balance drift.
Builds a contract-defined receivables eligibility and concentration deduction schedule rather than broad credit ratios or a lender verdict.
Uses contractual lower-of-cost and liquidation-value caps with sublimits; inventory accounting valuation and general credit memo do not calculate this borrowing certificate tier.
Reconciles permitted collateral capacity and facility commitment with drawings, letters of credit and blocks; a broad ratio memo does not establish usable availability.
Calculates separate daily-balance interest and undrawn commitment fee with actual day-count; a fixed amortizing loan payment calculator does not model revolving facility charges.
Produces contract-defined cash headroom across three debt-service periods, explicitly excluding net-leverage calculations and equity cures covered elsewhere.
Reconciles a specified cash-before-fixed-charges numerator to rent and debt payments; existing historical average earnings coverage is a different numerator and review horizon.
Aggregates funded and policy-weighted undrawn credit across a connected borrower group; sales-customer revenue concentration does not measure creditor exposure.
Shows dated contractual maturities against already accessible cash and confirmed refinancing; it does not invent restructuring terms or estimate creditor haircuts.
Builds contract-specific cash available for debt service from receipts, permitted operating outflows and working capital; earnings-to-cash review is not project financing eligibility.
Builds a sequential principal and interest profile from annual qualifying cash and target service cover, rather than static debt capacity ratios.
Discounts qualifying cash through the remaining loan term at the financing-agreement rate; historical earnings cover and enterprise WACC valuation measure different cash.
Separates authorized reserve draws, required coverage, funded top-ups and actual shortfalls; unrestricted treasury cash alone cannot establish a debt reserve movement.
Allocates project qualifying cash in supplied senior-service, reserve and junior-service priority, distinct from recovery restructuring or private fund carried-interest waterfalls.
Rolls equity-first cash draws and finite committed debt through construction costs; EVM earned-value indices do not track financing sources or undrawn commitments.
Builds noncircular capitalized interest using opening debt and explicitly timed draws; amortizing payment examples do not model construction funding timing.
Compares current cost to complete plus explicit contingency with undrawn eligible commitments; EVM cost performance forecasts do not establish available completion funding.
Separates approved service deductions, contract caps and operating cash on an infrastructure availability payment; ordinary invoice totals do not establish this capped contract bridge.
Models paid road passages, tariff realization and operating cash over three years; an online store spend/cohort forecast uses different demand and collection units.
Tracks input mass to good output, scrap proceeds and conversion cash per good unit; standard price/usage variance does not reconcile this physical yield and recovery bridge.
Reconciles a shared service cost pool across observed workload and unused capacity; channel ROI comparisons do not provide this capacity-based allocation identity.
Checks a supplied two-product plan against one financial bottleneck and contribution bridge; it neither reruns general production planning nor claims an optimized mix.
Reconciles paid time, available client hours, billed fees and actual delivery cash; an hourly-rate target calculator does not model observed utilization and workload.
Reconciles actual room-night sales to channel commissions and occupied-room cash costs; this avoids the existing optimizer scaffold and does not propose prices or overbooking.
Reconciles purchased mass, observed edible yield, saleable portions, batch cash and unserved capacity; a product parts cost sheet lacks this food-portion and batch timing bridge.
Tracks full-price and markdown units against one opening stock cohort with remaining stock and realized cash; discount margin arithmetic does not reconcile unsold quantity.
Uses delivered metered MWh, actual contract prices and operating cash over three periods; a generic budget lacks energy settlement units and contract boundaries.
Separates produced volume, billed water, current/arrears collection and receivable movement; a general cash forecast cannot identify this volume-to-billing-to-cash chain.
Builds operator trip cash from loaded and empty distance, actual fuel consumption and route charges; store shipping invoice analysis does not capture carrier empty-running economics.
Provides a bounded incremental keep-versus-replace cash comparison with time-zero proceeds and terminal value; broad fleet planning does not establish these source-specific cash timings.

Reconciles deidentified billed claims, approved adjustments, claim-applied cash and provider offsets to bank settlement; it neither recognizes revenue under accounting standards nor assesses medical coverage.
Builds a restriction movement and bank cash reconciliation separating available general cash; a spending evidence pack checks receipts and variance but does not supply this linked liquidity identity.
Reconciles input commodity price changes, physical consumption and approved partial customer pass-through; a static raw-parts cost breakdown does not model this signed margin movement.
A frozen forecast backtest, accessible-cash bridge and ordered settlement ladder create an audit of timing and restrictions beyond broad 30/60/90 forecasts.

semantic_controls.cross_domain_boundary: Private-deals agent reserves net-leverage and EBITDA equity cure, acquisition/fund/VC terms and private fund waterfalls; operating-credit covers DSCR cash, CFADS, project payment priority and operating schedules.
resolved_design_findings: Replaced factory-overhead absorption duplicate with explicit shared-service activity/idle-capacity allocation.
Narrowed generic covenant headroom to three-period debt-service qualifying cash, excluding net-leverage/equity cure.
Made signed FX hedge delivery explicit: buy foreign is positive; sell foreign negative; buy-forward settlement receives original payable, not an already-net residual.
Construction workflow distinguishes cost-only draws from end-period capitalized interest and tests total debt against commitment.
Project cash handoffs avoid re-deducting operating costs already included in source energy/toll cash.
Water utility workflow separates consumer collections from restricted award receipts, then reconciles usable bank cash.
